title: Lateen acceptance report
description: What the public acceptance gate checked on one candidate: the exact Node, npm, engine and package identities it ran with, the commit, the sha256 of the exact tarball it installed, the exact Mizzen version, and one result per case. The release workflow requires this report before it publishes and rejects a report whose identities, commit, digest or engine do not match the candidate.

node.description: The exact Node version that ran the acceptance gate.

npm.description: The exact npm version that packed and installed the candidate.

node.description: The tested package's declared Node engine from package.json.

commit.description: The commit the candidate was packed from.

digest.description: The sha256 of the tarball the gate installed, as hex.

mizzen.description: The exact engine version installed beside the candidate, not the range.

tarball.description: The file name of the tested tarball. Publishing uses this name and no other.

ok.description: True only when every case passed.

error.description: Why the case failed; absent when it passed.
